title: Backward problem for a degenerate viscous Hamilton-Jacobi equation: stability and numerical identification
summary: This work is devoted to the analysis of the backward problem for a viscous Hamilton-Jacobi equation with degenerate diffusion and a general Hamiltonian that is not necessarily quadratic. First, we focus on linear degenerate parabolic equations in the nondivergence setting. We prove the conditional stability of the backward problem using Carleman estimates. Then, by a linearization technique, we prove similar results for the nonlinear viscous Hamilton-Jacobi equation.
